meta.title: Social Media Agency Münster & NRW – Content, Reels & Management
meta.description: Social Media Komplett serves businesses in Münster and across NRW: content creation, on-site Reels production and social media management. Get in touch.

hero.eyebrow: Social media agency for Münster & NRW
hero.subtitle: Strategy, content, management and growth – all from a single source.
hero.imageAlt: Smartphone with floating social media icons, a glowing growth chart and turquoise waves

trust.title: Social media that doesn’t have to be squeezed in on the side.
trust.intro: Many businesses know that social media matters – but in day-to-day life there is no time for ideas, filming, editing and regular posts. That is exactly the work we take off your hands.

items.title: Everything from a single source
items.text: Strategy, content, Reels, publishing and community – you don’t have to coordinate three different service providers.

items.title: We come to you
items.text: Photos and videos are created right in your business. That way your presence shows what really makes your business special.

items.title: Clear coordination
items.text: You see content before it goes live and always know what is planned next.

items.title: Honest reporting
items.text: We report in plain language on what worked and what didn’t – without polished figures and without promises nobody can keep.

services.title: Our social media services
services.intro: You can book individual building blocks or have us manage your channels completely.

localCard.title: Local marketing & design
localCard.text: Menu design and new Google Maps photos for your business – we take care of the whole job, bookable individually or alongside your social media management.

process.title: How we work together
process.intro: From the first conversation to day-to-day operation: five clear steps, so you always know where you stand.

onsite.title: We film where your business comes to life.
onsite.text: Good content isn’t made at a desk. We come to your restaurant, salon, studio or shop and produce photos and videos while you’re open for business or on a dedicated shoot date.
points: Shoot dates that fit around your working day
Several Reels and photos from a single session
Preparation with a list of ideas and a schedule
Editing, subtitles and cover images included
onsite.areaText: We offer on-site shoots within roughly {km} km driving distance of {city}, depending on the distance and individual arrangement. Strategy, planning and ongoing management work regardless of location for businesses throughout NRW.

industries.title: For businesses that win customers over in person
industries.intro: We particularly enjoy working with local businesses where atmosphere, craftsmanship and people make the difference.

portfolio.title: What your content could look like
portfolio.intro: A selection of formats we produce for local businesses. The visuals shown are examples and do not represent client projects.

packages.title: Three packages, one goal: a reliable presence
packages.intro: From getting started to full-service management. We tailor the exact scope to your business in the initial consultation.

why.title: Why businesses hand over their channels

items.title: More time for your day-to-day business
items.text: Ideas, filming, editing, copy and publishing are down to us. You give your approval – that’s all.

items.title: Consistency instead of radio silence
items.text: A content calendar makes sure your channels stay active even in hectic weeks.

items.title: A consistent look and feel
items.text: Visual style, tone of voice and design fit together – and fit your brand.

items.title: Formats that suit the platform
items.text: Reels, carousels and Stories are produced the way they are actually used on Instagram, Facebook or TikTok.

items.title: Fixed routines
items.text: Clear dates for planning, shooting, approval and reporting instead of spontaneous one-off efforts.

items.title: Results you can follow
items.text: A regular report shows you reach, engagement and enquiries – and what we conclude from them.

blog.title: Know-how for your social media marketing
blog.intro: Practical guides and background for local businesses – no jargon.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Short answers to the questions we are asked most often.

contact.title: Ready for social media that simply works?
contact.text: Send us a few lines about your business. In a free initial consultation we work out which level of support makes sense – with no obligation.
points: A clear proposal instead of an off-the-shelf offer
